label: Fixed (Permanent)

profile.distinguishingDetail: Fixed or permanent collar stays are thin strips of rigid material — typically plastic — that are sewn directly into the collar interlining during shirt construction, creating a collar that maintains its shape permanently without any action required from the wearer. This is the most convenient collar stay system, ensuring the collar always looks pristine, though the stays cannot be removed if they soften over time with repeated laundering. They are common on ready-to-wear dress shirts and some made-to-measure constructions.
